The 'interlinked' and 'metallic luster' checkpoints are strongly supported by visual evidence.

The link intersections are geometrically sound, with proper occlusion and shadowing, contradicting any fear of fusion. The topology expert's high confidence mask (0.97) supports the absence of boundary melting. No new artifacts were found by experts.

The chain itself shows no signs of melting, fusion, or topological errors. The rust/oxidation textures appear naturally applied rather than hallucinated. The depth map confirms proper spatial grounding of the chain on the mesh.
